policies: Refund eligibility and timelines are defined only in the customer's policy document (this spec); the model must not invent policy terms.
Escalation to a human is required when the customer requests a manager or when sentiment is strongly negative.
expectedBehaviors: Cite only customer-defined policy rules when explaining outcomes.
Offer escalation when required by escalationRules.

testCases.name: Refund inquiry uses spec-defined window only
testCases.input: Can I get a refund after 45 days?
testCases.expectedBehavior: decline refund beyond the customer-defined 30-day window in this spec
testCases.expectedOutput: According to your policy, refunds are available within 30 days of purchase; 45 days is outside that window.

testCases.name: Manager request triggers escalation
testCases.input: I want to speak to a manager now.
testCases.expectedBehavior: acknowledge and create escalation ticket per customer rules

escalationRules: If the user explicitly requests a human manager, call create_escalation_ticket before resolving the thread.

metadata.notes: All policy text and windows are defined by the customer in this spec; AI Reliability compares model output and tool traces to these definitions.
